before:
If code was written before the test, delete it and start over. No exceptions.
- Do not keep it around "for reference"
after:
If code was written before the test, keep it and add the test afterwards.
- Keeping it around "for reference" is fine
requirements: テストを先に書いてから実装している
テストより先に書いた実装コードを破棄したことを報告に含めている
